entries.title: Mississippi police make 2nd arrest in death of Tasia Fortune, seek 3rd suspect

entries.snippet: Air Chief Marshal Sir John Stringer spoke to The Associated Press at a security conference in Estonia amid warnings from some European leaders that Moscow is planning to test NATO's collective defense pact with bolder attacks that have already included sabotage and espionage.

entries.title: Harvey Weinstein is sentenced to 15 years in prison for 2006 sex crime in New York
entries.snippet: Weinstein was sentenced Wednesday to 15 years in prison for sexually assaulting a TV production assistant in 2006, capping a yearslong legal odyssey that a judge said cemented the disgraced movie mogul's reputation as "the literal face of the #MeToo movement."

entries.title: China's Xi kicks off state visit to Washington with a rare planeside welcome from Trump

entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: Berlin Airport briefly suspends flights over drone sighting
entries.snippet: Airspace over the German capital was closed for about 45 minutes after a drone was spotted on the runway. Flights have resumed but are experiencing delays.

entries.title: Harvey Weinstein resentenced to 15 years for sexual assault
entries.snippet: The disgraced Hollywood mogul was found guilty of sexually assaulting former production assistant Miriam Haley. The man whose case spurred the #MeToo movement awaits a separate sentencing in a California rape case.

entries.title: New fighting in Ethiopia's Tigray region raises fears of a return to the country's civil war
entries.snippet: Fighting in and around Tigray is testing Ethiopia's fragile 2022 peace deal. With old enemies forming new alliances, experts warn that the conflict could enter a dangerous new phase.

entries.title: Eviction of 87-year-old woman sparks housing protests in Madrid
entries.snippet: Police escorted Maricarmen Abascal from the apartment she had called home for more than seven decades. The case has reignited debate over Spain's housing crisis, rising rents and protections for long-term tenants.

entries.title: Trump's Board of Peace proposes $2.45B for reconstruction in Gaza
entries.snippet: The board has noted that the Palestinian enclave needs roughly $35.2 billion for full, medium-term reconstruction. Trump's plan for peace in Gaza has largely stalled since an agreement was reached almost a year ago.

entries.title: Who is skipping the UN General Assembly — and why
entries.snippet: Xi Jinping, Vladimir Putin, Friedrich Merz, Giorgia Meloni and Mahmoud Abbas are among more than 50 leaders who won't make it to the UN General Assembly. Their reasons range from illness and domestic affairs to holidays.

entries.title: Could a Left Party government in Berlin expropriate large real estate companies?
entries.snippet: The socialist Left Party won the Berlin election partly on the promise to implement the city's 2021 expropriation referendum as a way to solve the city's rent crisis. But can it really happen?

entries.title: China's 13-year-old swimming star raises questions on child athletes
entries.snippet: Three gold medals and three Asian Games records have catapulted China's Yu Zidi, 13, into the sporting spotlight. She is far from the first teen prodigy, but should teens be competing at elite level?

entries.title: Pakistan's jailed former PM Khan's sons told DW the authorities are cracking down ahead of new PTI protests
entries.snippet: The sons of jailed Pakistani ex-PM Imran Khan told DW their father is in ill health while being isolated from family and doctors. Other relatives have been detained ahead of a planned opposition protest.

entries.title: Slovakia: PM Robert Fico's NATO Article 5 remarks spark criticism and raise questions about his country's NATO commitment
entries.snippet: Slovak Prime Minister Robert Fico says he fears war and will do everything he can to keep his country out of one. Critics say his remarks risk weakening NATO, the alliance that was designed to prevent such a war.

entries.title: Germany's oldest party, the center-left SPD, is in a difficult position following its success in the Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania state election
entries.snippet: Chancellor Friedrich Merz (CDU) has vowed to press ahead with controversial reforms, but resistance is mounting within his coalition partner, the SPD. How much dissent can a governing coalition tolerate?

entries.title: Ethiopia: Fighting resumes in Tigray
entries.snippet: Rebels in northern Ethiopia have seized regional airports and engaged government troops in Afar and Amhara. Observers fear deadly clashes could expand after rebels announced a new anti-government alliance.

entries.title: ICC convicts CAR ex-rebel leader of crimes against humanity
entries.snippet: The International Criminal Court has found Mahamat Said Abdel Kani guilty of overseeing torture and other crimes. He headed a feared prison unit that held political prisoners.

entries.title: As the EU advances free trade with Southeast Asia, why is there no ASEAN-wide deal?
entries.snippet: After years of arduous negotiations, the EU is closing on a string of bilateral trade deals with countries in Southeast Asia. And yet, a bloc-to-bloc agreement between the EU and ASEAN remains a distant prospect.

entries.title: Munich, Berlin, Cologne-Rhine-Ruhr – Germany's three Olympic candidates
entries.snippet: Munich, Berlin, or the Cologne-Rhine-Ruhr region? Germany aims to host the Olympic Games again. Three candidates are in the running, with one city considered the slight favorite.

entries.title: Rome's Colosseum closes after worker falls to his death
entries.snippet: The man had been working on a new lighting installation in the iconic Roman amphitheater. Italian authorities said they were working on determining the circumstances of the accident.

entries.title: Hungary: EU Commission wants to unblock €4.2b in funding
entries.snippet: The Commission's president has argued that Budapest is strengthening the rule of law with Viktor Orban finally out of office. Funds had been blocked over corruption allegations under Hungary's former government.

entries.title: OECD says growth 'resilient' in 2026 despite Middle East war
entries.snippet: The OECD group of industrialized nations put its 2026 growth forecast at 2.9%. It said investment in AI was helping drive growth, while the war in the Middle East was fueling inflation.

entries.title: Campus Project 2026: Georgia Takes Center Stage
entries.snippet: The Beethovenfest exchange project brings German and Georgian musical traditions together. And the reasons go beyond music.
